# Suez Water & Energy Technologies

Suez Water & Energy Technologies supplies water treatment, purification and solar water heating systems, components, consumables and spares in Kenya.

## Main sections
- [Products](https://suezwaterenergy.com/products): Complete water treatment and solar product catalogue.
- [About](https://suezwaterenergy.com/about): Mission, vision and core values.
- [Projects](https://suezwaterenergy.com/projects): Residential, commercial and institutional solutions.
- [Contact](https://suezwaterenergy.com/contact): Product guidance and quotation enquiries.

Products are grouped into water treatment and solar water heater categories. Availability and pricing are confirmed through a tailored enquiry.
